title: Serverus Maximus
body:
# 🧙‍♂️ Welcome to Serverus Maximus!

This is the official (and slightly chaotic) modpack for the Serverus Maximus Minecraft server – a magical land where crafting meets occasional explosions, questionable builds, and late-night mining sessions that go way too far.

Whether you’re here because you were invited, or just stumbled in by accident (oops), this modpack has everything you need to survive, thrive, and maybe cast a few spells along the way.

## 🔧 What’s Inside?
	•	A curated mix of performance and “oh wow that’s cool”
	•	Mods that make your life easier (or weirder)
	•	Everything tailored to work perfectly with our server setup
	•	Zero refunds if you get turned into a chicken

## 📜 Note:

This pack is not meant for public use – it’s made specifically for Serverus Maximus players. If you’re not part of the server, this modpack might make absolutely no sense. Or it might be the best mistake of your life. Who knows?
